sources.title: Intent access and providers
sources.locator: Key Features; Getting Started; Setup; Intent mobile
sources.finding: Free desktop app for macOS with Windows/Linux Alpha downloads. iOS app steers a paired computer. Agents include Auggie, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and Grok Build. Install and log into a provider; bundled CLI fallback is available.

sources.title: Intent context and tasks
sources.finding: Persistent editable spec and task notes carry goals, acceptance criteria, task status and dependency metadata. Coordinator delegates batches to implementors and verifier. Notes auto-save and can contain inline comments.

sources.title: Intent Git workflow
sources.finding: Workspaces use Git worktrees; Changes panel shows diffs, commits and pull requests. Users create/merge PRs or merge locally; agents monitor comments/CI. Home groups Needs you, Running and Done/idle workspaces and exposes fleet navigation.

sources.title: Intent agent runtime
sources.locator: Agents & Chat; Terminal; Browsers; Token Savings
sources.finding: Multiple concurrent workspace agents expose streaming output, stop/follow-up controls, provider quota failover, saved scripts and browser verification. Structured screenshots include accessibility trees and console output. Token view filters by agent/model; costs require provider reports. Daemon hooks and PR monitors wake agents on changes.

sources.title: Intent remote setup
sources.locator: intentd; pairing; web app; security and limits
sources.finding: Background service runs on user-controlled Linux, Mac or Windows hosts. Desktop/iOS clients pair using bearer tokens and TLS fingerprints. Web app can run on a VPS behind private HTTPS; browser access uses an access key. Web app stores machine tokens in plain text. Rotating pairing token revokes old access.

sources.title: Intent workspace transfer
sources.finding: Transfer includes Git repo, notes, conversations and assets with WIP snapshot; agents stop first and may restart at destination. Event history, terminal sessions and server settings stay on source. iOS supports messages, tasks, diffs, terminals and offline reading.

sources.title: Intent configuration
sources.finding: Global/workspace MCP servers and detected AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and skills become shared context. Specialists can use distinct providers/models/effort. Codex/Claude named profiles support accounts and automatic backup failover.

sources.title: Intent release notes
sources.finding: Current release v2.264.2 adds sidebar, auto-archive and secret requests. Mobile v1.1.8 is dated November 3, 2026. Provider profiles and quota failover shipped in v2.231.2.

sources.title: Intent docs
sources.locator: Introduction (first paragraph); Prerequisites; Open Source section
sources.finding: Calls Intent a free desktop app and says it is Apache 2.0 licensed. You need at least one agent provider (e.g. Auggie, Claude Code, Codex), logged in with your own account.

sources.title: intent-hq/intent LICENSE (Apache-2.0)
sources.finding: The Apache License 2.0 grants a perpetual, worldwide, no-charge, royalty-free copyright license to use and reproduce the code.
